title: Requirement
description: Snapshot of a requirement as exported from the requirements tool (StrictDoc), which remains the source of truth. Kept so traceability, coverage and reviews can be computed and audited against a fixed version

source_system.description: Where the requirement is authored: a Jira feature/story or a StrictDoc item. A product uses one source system, never both

version.description: Version: the git commit of the StrictDoc document, or the Jira issue's updated timestamp

parent_ids.description: Requirements this one is derived from or refines

verified_by_test_case_ids.description: Test cases that verify it (derivable from trace-matrix)

source.description: Source locator: StrictDoc document path and UID (docs/srs.sdoc#HLR-12) or Jira issue key (PAY-2231)

external_refs.description: The Jira feature issue or the StrictDoc item this requirement is; exactly one source system per product

key.description: Identifier in that system (Jira issue key, Xray test key, Zephyr key, StrictDoc UID, Fix Version id)

url.description: Resolved URL; the resolver derives it from integration-config when absent

synced_at.description: Last successful sync of this record to that system
